en: Therīgāthā 2.7 Dukanipāta Mittātherīgāthā The Verses of the Elder Nun Mittā, Second Fifty, Seventh Chapter I have crossed over the flood; I am now free from debt. I have reached the further shore; I have attained Nibbāna. My mind is well-liberated; I dwell in peace. I am one who has done her duty; I am a nun who has lived the holy life. I have abandoned all attachments; I am free from all bonds. I have cut off all ties; I am released from all fetters. I have destroyed the conceit "I am"; I am one who has no more becoming. I have realized the goal; I have attained the supreme security from bondage. I have seen the Dhamma; I am a disciple of the Well-Gone One.

I have reached the end of suffering; I am one who has no more birth. I have transcended all states of existence; I am one who has no more rebirth. I have reached the end of the journey; I am one who has no more returning. I have reached the end of the path; I am one who has no more wandering. I have reached the end of the round; I am one who has no more clinging. I have reached the end of the stream; I am one who has no more craving. I have reached the end of the ocean; I am one who has no more thirst. I have reached the end of the world; I am one who has no more ignorance. I have reached the end of the darkness; I am one who has no more delusion. I have reached the end of the forest; I am one who has no more defilements. I have reached the end of the thicket; I am one who has no more obscurations. I have reached the end of the wilderness; I am one who has no more hindrances. I have reached the end of the mire; I am one who has no more lust. I have reached the end of the swamp; I am one who has no more hatred. I have reached the end of the pit; I am one who has no more delusion. I have reached the end of the abyss; I am one who has no more pride. I have reached the end of the precipice; I am one who has no more conceit. I have reached the end of the mountain; I am one who has no more arrogance. I have reached the end of the peak; I am one who has no more vanity. I have reached the end of the summit; I am one who has no more self-importance. I have reached the end of the height; I am one who has no more egoism. I have reached the end of the expanse; I am one who has no more attachment. I have reached the end of the sphere; I am one who has no more grasping. I have reached the end of the field; I am one who has no more clinging. I have reached the end of the domain; I am one who has no more craving. I have reached the end of the range; I am one who has no more desire. I have reached the end of the reach; I am one who has no more longing. I have reached the end of the limit; I am one who has no more expectation. I have reached the end of the boundary; I am one who has no more hope. I have reached the end of the fence; I am one who has no more fear. I have reached the end of the wall; I am one who has no more dread. I have reached the end of the moat; I am one who has no more anxiety. I have reached the end of the rampart; I am one who has no more distress. I have reached the end of the gate; I am one who has no more sorrow. I have reached the end of the door; I am one who has no more grief. I have reached the end of the threshold; I am one who has no more lamentation. I have reached the end of the courtyard; I am one who has no more despair. I have reached the end of the hall; I am one who has no more dejection. I have reached the end of the chamber; I am one who has no more weariness. I have reached the end of the bed; I am one who has no more fatigue. I have reached the end of the couch; I am one who has no more exhaustion. I have reached the end of the seat; I am one who has no more toil. I have reached the end of the path; I am one who has no more wandering. I have reached the end of the road; I am one who has no more journeying. I have reached the end of the way; I am one who has no more going. I have reached the end of the course; I am one who has no more coming. I have reached the end of the track; I am one who has no more departing. I have reached the end of the trail; I am one who has no more returning. I have reached the end of the ford; I am one who has no more crossing. I have reached the end of the bridge; I have crossed over the flood. I have reached the end of the raft; I have gone beyond the ocean. I have reached the end of the boat; I have escaped the whirlpool. I have reached the end of the ship; I have crossed the great sea. I have reached the end of the vessel; I have reached the dry land. I have reached the end of the ferry; I have reached the further shore. I have reached the end of the crossing; I have attained Nibbāna. I have reached the end of the journey; I am a nun who has lived the holy life. I have reached the end of the practice; I am one who has done her duty. I have reached the end of the training; I am one who has no more learning. I have reached the end of the discipline; I am one who is fully trained. I have reached the end of the rule; I am one who has no more transgression. I have reached the end of the law; I am one who has no more violation. I have reached the end of the code; I am one who has no more fault. I have reached the end of the precept; I am one who has no more sin. I have reached the end of the vow; I am one who has no more breaking. I have reached the end of the observance; I am one who has no more neglect. I have reached the end of the conduct; I am one who has no more misconduct. I have reached the end of the behavior; I am one who has no more evil conduct. I have reached the end of the life; I am one who has no more death. I have reached the end of the span; I am one who has no more aging. I have reached the end of the term; I am one who has no more birth. I have reached the end of the duration; I am one who has no more existence. I have reached the end of the time; I am one who has no more future. I have reached the end of the age; I am one who has no more becoming. I have reached the end of the cycle; I am one who has no more rebirth. I have reached the end of the wheel; I am one who has no more turning. I have reached the end of the circle; I am one who has no more wandering. I have reached the end of the turn; I am one who has no more revolving. I have reached the end of the orbit; I am one who has no more circling. I have reached the end of the revolution; I am one who has no more rolling. I have reached the end of the rotation; I am one who has no more whirling. I have reached the end of the movement; I am one who has no more shaking. I have reached the end of the vibration; I am one who has no more trembling. I have reached the end of the agitation; I am one who has no more perturbation. I have reached the end of the disturbance; I am one who has no more commotion. I have reached the end of the turmoil; I am one who has no more unrest. I have reached the end of the conflict; I am one who has no more strife. I have reached the end of the battle; I am one who has no more war. I have reached the end of the fight; I am one who has no more combat. I have reached the end of the struggle; I am one who has no more contention. I have reached the end of the fray; I am one who has no more dispute. I have reached the end of the clash; I am one who has no more quarrel. I have reached the end of the contest; I am one who has no more rivalry. I have reached the end of the competition; I am one who has no more emulation. I have reached the end of the rivalry; I am one who has no more jealousy. I have reached the end of the envy; I am one who has no more malice. I have reached the end of the spite; I am
and the eighth day of the fortnight, as well as the fortnight of miracles— ”
delighting in the host of devas.
Today, with but a single meal,
shaven-headed and clad in the outer robe,
I shall not long for the host of devas.
“Having removed the dart from the heart.
